headline: Select equity mutual funds show strong SIP gains since last Diwali
hook: Eight equity funds deliver double-digit SIP returns
summary: Eight equity mutual funds have generated double-digit returns for SIP investors since Diwali last year. Samco Small Cap Fund led the pack with a 30.85% return, followed by Motilal Oswal Focused Fund and Bank of India Small Cap Fund. Despite these gains, 255 other equity funds reported negative returns during the same period. This highlights the impact of market volatility on individual fund performance.
why_it_matters: Portfolio performance varies significantly based on fund selection and market volatility.
winners_losers: Small cap investors gain / underperforming fund holders hurt

headline: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund acquires over 5% stake in MTAR Technologies through market purchases
hook: New major shareholder in MTAR Technologies
summary: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund has increased its holding in precision engineering firm MTAR Technologies to cross the 5% threshold through open market transactions. This significant institutional buying brings additional visibility to the company's stock. Retail investors track mutual fund stake movements to gauge institutional confidence in mid-cap engineering firms.
whats_next: Quarterly shareholding pattern filing for the next quarter
why_it_matters: Institutional buying signals strong fundamental confidence in the company.

headline: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund raises its stake in MTAR Technologies
summary: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund has increased its shareholding in precision engineering company MTAR Technologies. The move reflects institutional interest in the company, which supplies critical components to the clean energy, nuclear, and space sectors. Increased mutual fund backing provides validation of the company's growth outlook. Indian retail investors tracking mid-cap engineering stocks should note institutional accumulation trends.
why_it_matters: Institutional buying signals confidence in MTAR Technologies' growth pipeline.
winners_losers: MTAR Technologies gains / no clear losers
